exact.潮汐刚推向左，下一潮向右。: The tide just pushed left. Next tide goes right.
exact.这一列落不进去。: That column will not take it.
exact.只落在列出的列。: Drop only into a listed column.
exact.滑出 0 枚。左右挨着才会熔，叠在同一列不会。潮把不比邻列矮的顶壳推过去。: Spilled 0. Only side-by-side shells melt. A stack in one column does not. The tide pushes a top shell onto a neighbor that is no taller.
exact.把本局的最大尺寸、最好连锁、滑出次数和潮向写进你自己的 memory。平铺的井也: Write this run's largest size, best chain, spills, and tide direction into your own memory. A flat well still gets pushed. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
